policies.title: Bolivian ordinary passports: Bahamas visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The Bahamas' live visitor requirements table directly marks a Bolivian passport as not requiring a visa for a three-month visit; current legislation's designated-country rule is consistent with that visitor result.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bolivian passport visitor for up to three months in the official country table.
Work, education, residence, special travel documents and final immigration admission are outside this visitor baseline.
The table retains an internal 2014 date despite current Bahamas government hosting; current designated-country legislation is used only as legal corroboration, not as a general omission inference.

policies.title: DR Congo ordinary passports: Bahamas advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Bahamas legislation expressly designates the Democratic Republic of Congo as visa-required and defines the visa as a consular endorsement placed in the passport; its eVisa site supports online filing but not electronic issuance.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Democratic Republic of the Congo passport visitor for leisure; the Regulations categorize tourist visas as leisure travel.
The visa is an endorsement in the passport issued by or for the Minister after consular examination; online filing does not make this an electronically issued visa.
A single-entry tourist visa is valid for one entry within three months; final admission remains subject to Immigration Act requirements.

conflicts.explanation: The current Bahamas legal definition requires a consular endorsement placed in the passport. The March 2026 eVisa service establishes online application mechanics only and allows in-person visa-office resubmission; it does not establish electronic issuance.

unresolved.reason: South Sudan is not directly named in the live Bahamas visitor table or the current statutory designated-country schedule. Neither omission is normalized as a visa-free or visa-required result, and the 2026 eVisa FAQ does not provide a South Sudan nationality result or prove electronic issuance.
